description: This file defines utility classes and functions for pattern matching within torch.fx graphs, including SubgraphMatcher and InternalMatch classes, for matching subgraph patterns in PyTorch's FX graph representation.

classes.name: InternalMatch
classes.description: A data class representing a specific match of a subgraph pattern within a graph, including node mappings, anchors, placeholder nodes, and return nodes.

classes.name: SubgraphMatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for matching a pattern graph within a larger FX graph, supporting configurable options for matching output and placeholders, with methods for performing the pattern matching process.

methods.name: _init_logger()
methods.description: Initializes and configures the logger based on environment variable PYTORCH_MATCHER_LOGLEVEL.

methods.name: InternalMatch.__copy__
methods.description: Creates and returns a shallow copy of the InternalMatch instance.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SubgraphMatcher with a pattern graph and matching options, validating pattern nodes, and setting pattern-related attributes.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher._match_attributes
methods.description: Compares attributes of two nodes, primarily focusing on tensor constants, to determine if they match.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher._nodes_are_equal
methods.description: Checks if two nodes are considered equal for matching purposes, considering op type, target, and optional name match.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher._is_contained
methods.description: Determines if the matched nodes form a self-contained subgraph without external leaks.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher._remove_overlapping_matches
methods.description: Filters out overlapping matches from a list of InternalMatch instances, ensuring non-overlapping subgraphs.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher._match_literals
methods.description: Matches a pattern literal node or constant against a graph node, handling placeholders as wildcards.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher._match_nodes
methods.description: Recursively attempts to match a pattern node to a graph node, including traversing input arguments and knotting match state.

methods.name: SubgraphMatcher.match
methods.description: Executes the pattern match within the provided FX graph, returning a list of InternalMatch objects representing each match found.
